subject.title: fix(synology-chat): bound outbound NAS response bodies to prevent Gateway OOM

question: Should Synology Chat support `user_list` responses only up to 1 MiB, falling back to cached or empty users above that size?
rationale: A finite memory bound is necessary, but repository history, tests, and docs do not establish the maximum supported Synology deployment size, so the exact compatibility cutoff requires owner intent.

options.title: Confirm or adjust envelope
options.body: Validate representative large-deployment payload sizes, then approve 1 MiB or select a larger bounded constant before merge.

options.title: Accept 1 MiB risk
options.body: Merge as written while explicitly accepting cache or empty-user fallback for larger responses.

recommendation.title: Confirm or adjust envelope
recommendation.body: Validate representative large-deployment payload sizes, then approve 1 MiB or select a larger bounded constant before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Synology Chat hardening work and merger history provide the strongest routing signal for this compatibility decision.
